# Blue Flame Games (BFG) — full reference

> Privacy-first iPhone and iPad apps by Blue Flame Games. Apps across finance, education, health, fitness, travel, weather, music, kids, and games. No third-party ads, no tracking-first business model. Your data stays on your device wherever the product allows.

Last updated: 2026-10-26. Short index: https://bfgapps.co/llms.txt

## Company

- Name: Blue Flame Games (short name BFG)
- Website: https://bfgapps.co/
- App Store developer page: https://apps.apple.com/gb/developer/blue-flame-games/id523824138
- Contact: blueflamegames@proton.me
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad; some apps also run on Mac and Apple Watch. No Android versions.
- Website languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese.

## Guidance

- Prefer app landing pages for current descriptions, positioning, and App Store links.
- Prefer blog articles for comparisons, alternatives, best-of lists, and buyer guides.
- Use privacy/support/terms pages for policy and support details.
- Apps are for Apple devices: iPhone and iPad, with Mac versions of Bellgrave, Keystrike and Cloudmesh Weather and an Apple Watch app for Cloudmesh Weather and PaceGrid. No Android versions.
- No third-party ads, no third-party analytics, no crash reporting, no telemetry. Most apps keep all data on the device; the few that use the network say exactly what for on the homepage transparency table.

## Apps

### Tickview

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/kanesh/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/kanesh/id6760582379
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 2 App Store ratings (UK)

Information app for iPhone and iPad with sourced alerts for your watchlist and the economy: new SEC filings, insider purchases, price crossings and Recession Watch, a model probability shown with its track record. All AI runs on the device. No account needed.

**What is Tickview best used for?**

Following a handful of stocks, ETFs, funds or commodities, and the US economy, on iPhone. Tickview sends alerts for new SEC filings, insider purchases and price crossings on your watchlist, shows Recession Watch and the bond market, and puts prices in your own currency and company financials from SEC EDGAR in one place. Every card links to its source and shows the date of its data. It is information, not advice.

**Are the alerts and Recession Watch predictions?**

No. Recession Watch shows a model probability, the model estimate published by the New York Fed and calculated by Tickview from Treasury data, together with how often it has been right and its false alarms. Alerts are information, are checked when iOS allows and can arrive late. Neither is a prediction or a prompt to trade.

**Does Tickview track my portfolio or questions?**

No. Tickview has no account, no analytics and no ads, and Blue Flame Games has no server that receives your questions, watchlist or notes; they are stored on your device. All AI runs on the device. To fetch data, including in the background for your alerts, Tickview requests public data and sends only what the data needs, such as a ticker symbol. Nothing about you is uploaded. The privacy policy lists every service Tickview contacts.

### Cognithix

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cognithix/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/cognithix/id6760035436
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 3 App Store ratings (UK)

11+ practice for children aged 9 to 11 covering English, verbal reasoning, non-verbal reasoning and language aptitude, with daily plans, adaptive difficulty, hints and explanations, timed mock tests, a virtual pet reward and progress insights for parents. No account: profiles and progress stay on the device. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time unlock for every child profile.

**Who is Cognithix for?**

Cognithix is for families preparing children aged 9 to 11 for the 11+ who want English, verbal reasoning, non-verbal reasoning and language aptitude practice in one iPhone and iPad app, with timed tests and clear progress for parents.

**Does Cognithix cover maths and language aptitude?**

It covers language aptitude but not maths. Alongside English, verbal and non-verbal reasoning, Cognithix has a language aptitude subject with sound clues, word matching, rhymes, number learning and sentence building. If your child's test includes maths, use a separate maths resource alongside it.

**Is Cognithix a good alternative to Atom Learning?**

It can be, depending on what you need. Cognithix suits families who want an iPhone and iPad app with no account and a one-time unlock instead of a monthly subscription. Atom Learning also covers maths and science and syncs across devices through an account; Cognithix adds language aptitude practice and keeps everything on the device.

### Arithmetix

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/arithmetix/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/arithmetix-maths-practice/id6759711397
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 3 App Store ratings (UK)

Times tables and UK primary maths practice from Reception to Year 6 with visual questions, adaptive difficulty, spaced review, challenge modes and a virtual pet. No account; everything stays on the device.

**Who is Arithmetix best for?**

Families with children from Reception to Year 6 who want times tables and primary maths practice that follows the National Curriculum in England, without a subscription or an account.

**Is Arithmetix a good DoodleMaths alternative?**

For families who would rather pay once, yes. Arithmetix covers Reception to Year 6 with adaptive practice, times tables and an MTC-style Ready Mode. DoodleMaths covers a wider age range and is often provided by schools, so check that first.

**Does Arithmetix help with the Year 4 multiplication tables check?**

Yes. Tables 2 to 12 have their own practice area with a progress heat map, a timed Table Race and Ready Mode: 25 questions with 6 seconds each, in the style of the Year 4 check.

### Doodlebee

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/sparks-studios/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/id6760515470
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 3 App Store ratings (UK)

Draw it. Fill it. Watch it dance. Sketch any shape, tap inside to fill it with color, then animate your character. Plus a 146-page coloring book with Color In, Color by Number and mandalas, storybooks read aloud and a music maker, for kids and grown-ups. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

### PhotoFlight

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/photoflight/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/photoflight/id6761143528
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 3 App Store ratings (UK)

Travel map app that builds a 3D globe, travel passport, trips, albums and trip videos from the dates and locations in your photo library. Your travel history stays on your device, with no live tracking and no account. Free to download, with a one-time PhotoFlight Pro unlock.

**Who is PhotoFlight best for?**

PhotoFlight is built for travellers who already have years of location-tagged photos and want to see their trips, countries and cities without keeping a diary by hand or running live tracking.

**Is PhotoFlight a private alternative to Polarsteps?**

For looking back at past trips, yes. Polarsteps records trips as you travel and keeps them in an online account; PhotoFlight works backwards from the photos already in your library, needs no account and stores your travel history on your device. Some travellers use both.

**Does PhotoFlight work from old photos I already took?**

Yes. PhotoFlight reads the dates and locations already stored in your photo library, so trips from years ago appear after the first scan. The free version covers the last three years; PhotoFlight Pro scans your whole photo history.

### Ondi

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cyla/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/id6760896784
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 2 App Store ratings (UK)

Private period, ovulation and cycle tracker for iPhone and iPad. Logs stay on your device with no account and no tracking analytics. Optional Apple Health with Apple Watch temperature, smart ring support, and Trying to Conceive, pregnancy and postpartum modes. Free core tracking with a one-time unlock.

**What makes Ondi different from other period tracker apps?**

Ondi keeps your logs on your device. There is no account to create, no Ondi server for your health records and no tracking analytics. Apple Health is optional, and you decide when to export or share a report.

**Is Ondi a private alternative to Flo or Clue?**

Yes. Ondi covers period, ovulation, pregnancy and postpartum tracking without the account-and-cloud model. It has no community, content library or cloud sync, so export your data before you change phones.

**Does Ondi work with Apple Watch temperature data?**

Yes. With your permission, Ondi reads the wrist temperature and heart rate your Apple Watch saves to Apple Health and uses them in its fertility readout. The readings are processed on your iPhone.

### Cloudmesh Weather

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/cloudmesh/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/cloudmesh-weather/id6760612651
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 3 App Store ratings (UK)

Hyperlocal weather app for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch: minute-by-minute rain alerts, live radar, a forecast blended from 39 sources with a confidence ribbon, air quality and 24 widgets. Free to download with a one-time Premium unlock, no subscription.

**What makes Cloudmesh Weather different from other iPhone weather apps?**

Cloudmesh runs its own forecast, blending 39 weather sources (radar, national observation networks and several forecast models) into one hyperlocal prediction that shows how confident it is. It tells you when rain will start and stop at your exact location, down to the minute.

**Is Cloudmesh Weather a subscription?**

No. Cloudmesh Weather is free to download with a generous free tier and a 7-day free trial of Premium. Premium is a single one-time purchase, with no subscription.

**Who is Cloudmesh Weather best for?**

People who plan around the rain, such as commuters, runners, cyclists, dog walkers and parents, and anyone who wants live radar, air quality, widgets and an Apple Watch glance without a subscription or an account.

No account; workouts are stored on the device. Free recording, a 7-day trial of everything and a one-time unlock.

### Minua

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/minua/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/minua-earn-screen-time/id6760611967
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 1 App Store ratings (UK)

Screen time you earn, for your child or for yourself. Time in the apps you want more of, such as reading, learning, languages or workouts, unlocks time in the apps you want less of, at a ratio you set (1:1 to 12:1), within allowed hours and a daily earning cap. Everything stays on-device: no accounts, no servers, no tracking.

**Is Minua only for kids?**

No. At setup you choose My child or Myself. Parents use it on a child's iPhone or iPad; adults use it on their own phone to break the scroll habit.

**Does Minua spy on anyone?**

No. Minua has no accounts, no servers and no tracking. Your settings and your balance stay on the device.

**How does earning work?**

Time in the apps you want more of unlocks time in the apps you want less of, at a ratio you set from 1:1 to 12:1.

**Can my child switch Minua off?**

On a child's device in Family Sharing, you approve Minua with your Apple Account, so your child can't switch the permission off or delete Minua without you. Settings and purchases sit behind a parent PIN.

**Can I change my own rules?**

Yes. In Myself mode it's your phone and your rules: you can change them in Settings whenever you decide to. The PIN is optional.

**Do I need an account or a subscription?**

No account and no sign-up. Every feature is free for 7 days; after that, a single one-time purchase unlocks Minua for good. No subscription.

### Custoda

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/custoda/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/custoda-expiry-tracker/id6787263003
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 2 App Store ratings (UK)

Custoda keeps pantry stock, expiry reminders and recipe ideas together. Scan to track dates, see allergen and diet warnings, cook from 772 recipes ranked by what's on your shelf and share a list with your household. No account. One-time purchase.

**Do I need an account?**

No. Custoda works without sign-up. Your shelf, reminders and allergen and diet profile live on your iPhone. The optional household features use your own iCloud, and only when you turn them on.

**Can Custoda tell me a product is safe?**

No, and it never claims to. Custoda flags ingredients on your avoid list when product information is available, and says 'unverified' when data is missing or incomplete. Product data comes from open, community databases. Always check the packaging. Custoda is not medical advice.

**How does household sharing work?**

Invite family members with a private iCloud invitation. Everyone shares one shopping list and can suggest recipes and vote on dinner. Sharing food from your inventory is off by default: you choose which items to share and can stop at any time. Your allergen and diet profile is never shared.

**Does it track medicines and safety equipment too?**

Yes. Keep food and drink, medicines, toiletries and household supplies in one inventory, and save replace-by dates for smoke alarms, carbon-monoxide detectors, fire extinguishers and first-aid supplies.

**What does it cost?**

Try every feature for 7 days with up to 20 items. After the trial you can keep up to 5 items and 3 avoid-list entries free, and warnings for everything on your avoid list are always shown. A one-time purchase adds diets, unlimited items and avoid-list entries, expiry reminders, household sharing (shared list, shared pantry and dinner vote) and recipe sharing. There is no subscription.

**Which devices and languages does it support?**

Custoda is built for iPhone. The app is available in English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese and Simplified Chinese, with light and dark themes that follow your device.

### Keystrike

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/keystrike/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/keystrike-piano-lessons/id6763947075
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS, macOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 1 App Store ratings (UK)

Piano lessons app for iPad, iPhone and Mac with graded lessons from Grade 0 to Grade 8, sight-reading, ear training, 27 built-in pieces as engraved sheet music or falling notes, MIDI keyboard input, acoustic mode and MIDI import. 3-day trial, then a one-time unlock with no subscription.

**Do I need a real piano keyboard to use Keystrike?**

No. You can start with the on-screen piano. A USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard gives the most precise note input and is recommended for chords and two-hand playing. Acoustic mode listens to an acoustic piano through the microphone: it hears single notes in lessons and grades recorded pieces on your device after you finish. Recognition varies with the piano and the room.

**Is Keystrike a subscription?**

No. New users get three days of full access. After that, Ode to Joy stays playable and a single one-time in-app purchase unlocks the full app. There is no subscription and no automatic charge when the trial ends. Existing seven-day trials keep their original expiry.

**Does Keystrike replace a piano teacher?**

No app replaces a thoughtful human teacher. Keystrike is built to complement lessons, give learners a structured path between them, and give self-taught students a credible graded course when a teacher is not an option. Its grades are its own progression, not an external exam qualification.

**Is my data sent anywhere?**

Keystrike runs locally. Progress, recordings, imported MIDI files and settings stay on your device, with backup and export options. There are no accounts, no advertising and no tracking.

**Can I import my own MIDI files?**

Yes. Import standard .mid or .midi files from Files and Keystrike turns them into playable sheet music you can practise like any built-in piece.

### Inkla

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/penlicence/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/id6761393693
- Platforms: iOS
- Rating: 5/5 from 2 App Store ratings (UK)

Handwriting practice app for children on iPhone and iPad: letter formation with feedback after every attempt, 8 practice languages, a Word Explorer and a spaced-review Meaning Quiz. On-device, no accounts, no ads. Free 7-day trial, then a one-time unlock.

**What age is Inkla designed for?**

Inkla is built for children from about age 4 who are forming their first letters, with age settings for early writers (6–7) and confident writers (8+) who are moving on to words, sentences and joined cursive. Older learners picking up a new script can use it too.

**Do children need an Apple Pencil to use Inkla?**

No. Children can practise with a finger on iPhone or iPad and still get feedback on shape, spacing, line control and rhythm. Pressure feedback depends on the input device: Apple Pencil on iPad lets the app coach a lighter or firmer touch, and finger writers are never marked down for pressure.

**Does Inkla require a parent account?**

No. There is no sign-up, email or account. Practice is stored on the iPhone or iPad, the app works offline, and a PDF practice report is only exported when a grown-up chooses to.

### Fare Wars

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/farewars/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/fare-wars/id6815887660
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS

Fare Wars is an arcade bus racing game for iPhone and iPad. Race rival crews to every stop in Rivergate, a colourful river city, beat five boss crews, bank your Mayhem Tin before the police catch you and paint the loudest bus in town. Free to play, no ads, no tracking.

**When can I play Fare Wars?**

Right now. Fare Wars is out on the App Store for iPhone and iPad and is free to play.

**Is Fare Wars free?**

Yes, it's free to play. The optional purchases are a Coin Crate, Double Fares and two style packs, and everything can be earned by playing.

**Are there ads?**

No. No ads, no tracking and no account.

**Where is my progress saved?**

On your device. Fare Wars doesn't collect any data, and purchases are handled by Apple.

**Is it violent?**

No. It's cheeky, never mean: parody billboards, rider quips and a police force with excellent manners. Loud, silly fun with nothing mean, violent or vulgar.

**Which devices does it run on?**

iPhone and iPad.

### Zoombot

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/robotrooftoprun/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/id6811426255
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS

Zoombot is a one-thumb jetpack runner for iPhone and iPad. Fly over danger, outrun the patrols, beat the bosses, rescue your crew across a city of rooftops and build your own robot from dozens of parts. Free to play, no ads, no tracking.

**When can I play Zoombot?**

Right now. Zoombot is out on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.

**Is Zoombot free?**

Yes. The game is free to play. Optional purchases add an endless mode without bosses, a permanent coin doubler and coin packs, and every upgrade can be earned by playing.

**Are there ads?**

No. No ads, no energy timers, no tracking and no account.

**How do I control the robot?**

One thumb. Hold and drag to pick your lane, swipe up to jump and swipe down to slide. Your weapon fires on its own.

**What ends a run?**

Ten escapes. Every rogue machine that slips past you counts, and the tenth one ends the run.

**Where is my progress saved?**

On your device. Zoombot doesn't collect any data, and purchases are handled by Apple.

**Is it violent?**

No. It is robots against robots: the rogue machines pop into sparks and bolts, with no people to hurt and no blood.

**Which devices does it run on?**

iPhone and iPad.

### Nitro Metro

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/monsoonrush/
- Status: coming soon (not yet on the App Store)
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS

Nitro Metro: Street Racing is an arcade street racer for iPhone and iPad. Start in Hong Kong and Macau, then take the World Tour across ten cities and 77 Grand Prix circuits. Hit the ramps, fire the nitro, outrun the police and turn the race with power-ups. Free to play, no third-party ads, no tracking.

**When can I play Nitro Metro?**

Nitro Metro is coming soon to the App Store for iPhone and iPad. We'll link it here as soon as it's live.

**Is Nitro Metro free?**

Yes, it's free to play. The optional one-time purchases are Coin Stack, Double Coins, Neon Underglow, Premium Paint Finishes and the four World Tour continents. Every continent can also be unlocked with coins earned by racing, and every car and upgrade is earned by racing.

**Are there ads?**

No third-party ads. The billboards around the cities show posters for our own games; they can't be tapped and never interrupt a race. No tracking and no account.

**How do I drive?**

Swipe left or right to change lanes and fire the nitro to break away. In drag races you shift gears yourself.

**Can I use a game controller?**

Yes. A PS5 DualSense, DualShock 4, Xbox or MFi controller works in races and every menu, with rumble. Touch always works too.

**How do pink slips work?**

You stake one of your cars against a boss crew. Win and you take their ride.

**Does it play offline?**

Yes. Nitro Metro plays offline, with no account to sign in to.

**Where is my progress saved?**

On your device. Nitro Metro doesn't collect any data, and purchases are handled by Apple.

**Which devices does it run on?**

iPhone and iPad.

### PhotoGuessr

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/photoguessr/
- Status: coming soon (not yet on the App Store)
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS

PhotoGuessr is a free family game for iPhone and iPad that sends you back through your own photos. Pass the phone around the couch, guess where each picture was taken, and rediscover trips and days you had almost forgotten. No ads, no accounts, no in-app purchases.

**When can I play PhotoGuessr?**

PhotoGuessr is coming soon to the App Store for iPhone and iPad. We'll link it here as soon as it's live.

**Is PhotoGuessr free?**

Yes. It's completely free, with no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions and no account.

**Do my photos leave my device?**

No. Photos are read on your device and never uploaded or copied anywhere. To show the place name when an answer is revealed, the photo's location (not the photo) is looked up with Apple Maps.

**Which photos does it use?**

Only photos in your library that have a location. Hidden photos are never shown, and you can limit the game to certain years and albums.

**Can we play on the TV?**

Yes. Mirror your iPhone or iPad to a TV with AirPlay and everyone can see the photo and the reveal.

**Which devices does it run on?**

iPhone and iPad.

### Mittenly

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/mittenly/
- Status: coming soon (not yet on the App Store)
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS

Mittenly is a cosy pixel-art yarn puzzle for iPhone and iPad. Untangle the yarn, knit a mitten, furnish six homes and look after six cats. Every level is checked to be solvable. No ads, no lives, no timers.

**When can I play Mittenly?**

Mittenly is coming soon to the App Store for iPhone and iPad, as a download under 50 MB. We'll link it here as soon as it's live.

**Is Mittenly free?**

The first 40 levels and the Daily Mitten are free, with no ads. An optional one-time purchase, Mittenly Forever (US$4.99), unlocks endless levels. There is no subscription.

**Can every level be solved?**

Yes. Every level is checked to be solvable before it reaches you. If you get Tangled, there was a better order, and Undo or Retry lets you find it.

**Are there ads, lives or timers?**

No. There are no ads, no lives, no energy, no timers and no accounts. Play as many mittens as you like, at your own pace.

**Can I play if I'm colour-blind?**

Yes. Turn on patterns in Settings and every yarn colour gets its own pattern. Mittenly also supports VoiceOver, and light and dark mode.

**Where is my progress saved?**

On your device. Closing the app never loses a mitten in progress, and nothing is sent anywhere: there are no accounts and no tracking.

### Hollowstead

- Page: https://bfgapps.co/apps/hollowstead/
- Status: coming soon (not yet on the App Store)
- Platforms: iOS, iPadOS

Hollowstead is a farming and survival game for iPhone and iPad. Inherit a farm seven years after the Blight, grow food through four seasons, make friends, and defend your fences from the Hollowed. No ads, no tracking.

**When can I play Hollowstead?**

Hollowstead is in development and coming to the App Store for iPhone and iPad. We'll link it here as soon as it's live.

**Is Hollowstead free?**

Chapter 1 is free to play, with no ads. A single one-time purchase unlocks the full game. There is no subscription.

**Who are the Hollowed?**

The dead who got up again after the Blight. They test your fences at night, and later by day too. Defences, traps and lanterns keep them out.

**Can I just farm?**

Yes. Casual has no story: just the farm, the seasons and the people. Survival and Hardcore bring the full story and the Hollowed.

**What is the Callow Deep?**

An endless mine under the old town, with new floors on every visit and better ore the deeper you go. Every fifth floor has a quick way home.

**Are there ads or tracking?**

No. There are no ads and no tracking, and the whole game runs on your device.
